# hereplatform_app_api_key (Resource)

Manages an API key of a HERE platform app.

HERE allows at most two API keys per app. The plaintext key is stored in the Terraform state as the sensitive `value` attribute, so protect the state accordingly. Deleting a key is permanent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hereplatform_app" "example" {
  name = "example-web"
}

resource "hereplatform_app_api_key" "example" {
  app_hrn    = hereplatform_app.example.hrn
  name       = "example-web-browser"
  expires_at = "2030-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}

# The plaintext key, to hand over to a secret store.
output "example_api_key" {
  value     = hereplatform_app_api_key.example.value
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_hrn` (String) HRN of the app that owns the key. Changing it replaces the key.
- `name` (String) Name or short description of the key. Updated in place.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the key can authenticate requests. Defaults to `true`.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry as an RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2030-01-02T15:04:05Z`, kept at millisecond precision. Omit it for a key that never expires. Updated in place.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `hrn` (String) HRN of the API key, such as `hrn:here:account::<realm>:apikey/<key-id>`. It carries an obfuscated form of the key and cannot authenticate requests.
- `id` (String) HRN of the API key.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Plaintext API key (HERE `apiKeyId`), passed as the `apiKey` query parameter.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# API keys are imported by "<app_hrn>,<apikey_hrn>", because HERE reads keys only
# through their app. The plaintext value is recovered on import.
terraform import hereplatform_app_api_key.example "hrn:here:account::myrealm:app/AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrSt,hrn:here:account::myrealm:apikey/AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUvWxYz0123456789-AbCd"
```
